create_swin_transformer_model: create a SwinTransformer model with configurable image size, patch size, embed dimensions, and attention heads
build_swin_transformer_trunk: build a SwinTransformerTrunk module from a VISSL AttrDict configuration for model registration
run_window_attention_forward: run window-based multi-head self attention with relative position bias on partitioned feature windows
test_swin_transformer_block: test a SwinTransformerBlock with shifted window partitioning, cyclic shift, and residual connections
summarize_patch_merging_layer: summarize a PatchMerging layer that downsamples features by concatenating 2x2 non-overlapping patches
